profile.name: Ledgerly Inc.
profile.summary: US mid-size fintech (~600 employees). Licensed money transmitter in 48 states. Consumer app offering P2P payments, debit card (issued via a partner bank), cross-border remittances to 30 countries, and a custodial crypto wallet (buy/sell/send BTC, ETH, USDC). Small-business invoicing. No lending, no securities brokerage, not a bank.
businessLines: Prepaid / debit card program via sponsor bank
applies: Bank Secrecy Act / AML, FinCEN rules for MSBs, Travel Rule, CVC rules
OFAC sanctions screening (customers and counterparties, incl. crypto addresses)
CFPB rules: Reg E (EFTA), remittance rule, prepaid rule, UDAAP, larger-participant rules for payment apps
Consumer data privacy / GLBA, open banking (1033)
FTC consumer protection that touches payment apps
Stablecoin / digital asset regulation affecting custodial wallets
doesNotApply: SEC rules for exchanges, broker-dealers, investment companies, SRO rule filings
Bank capital rules, bank holding company filings, deposit insurance assessments
Tax rules unless they create information reporting for payment platforms or digital assets
Sanctions actions only matter via the screening program, not individually

aml-bsa.description: AML/BSA program, FinCEN, Travel Rule, SARs

consumer-payments.description: Reg E, remittances, prepaid, CFPB supervision, UDAAP

screenedOut.title: Continuation of the National Emergency With Respect to the Threat From Securities Investments That Finance Certain Companies of the People's Republic of China
screenedOut.reason: Emergency covers securities investments in Chinese military-industrial companies (NS-CMIC); targets securities investment, not payment or wallet services Ledgerly offers.

screenedOut.reason: BIS notice with no abstract or detail indicating any payments, sanctions screening or crypto obligation; export control matter.

screenedOut.reason: SBA disaster declaration for Texas; no payment-related requirement.

screenedOut.title: Sunshine Act Meeting Notice
screenedOut.reason: FTC closed Sunshine Act meeting notice; no obligation created.

screenedOut.title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Requesting Comment Notice of Taxpayer Statement Regarding Refund

screenedOut.title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records
screenedOut.reason: SSA Privacy Act system of records notice binds SSA, not private fintechs.

screenedOut.reason: DoD information collection for USD(P&R); unrelated to Ledgerly's business.

screenedOut.title: Data Collection Available for Public Comments
screenedOut.reason: SBA 60-day paperwork notice; no new duty on Ledgerly.

screenedOut.title: Records Schedules; Availability and Request for Comments
screenedOut.reason: NARA records schedules for federal agencies; imposes nothing on Ledgerly.

screenedOut.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To List Shares of the Bitwise 10 Crypto Index ETF Under NYSE Arca Rule 8.201-E (Generic)

screenedOut.title: Presidential Declaration of a Major Disaster for Public Assistance Only for the State of Florida
screenedOut.reason: SBA disaster declaration for Florida; no impact on Ledgerly's compliance duties.

screenedOut.title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission to the Office of Management and Budget for Review and Approval; Comment Request; Information Collection for the State, Local, Tribal and Private Sector (SLTPS) Clearance Program
screenedOut.reason: DHS/CISA clearance program information collection; unrelated to Ledgerly.

screenedOut.title: Specific Listing for 3-Chloromethcathinone, A Currently Controlled Schedule I Substance
screenedOut.reason: DEA drug scheduling listing for 3-CMC; already controlled as a positional isomer, so it adds no AML, sanctions or payments obligation for Ledgerly.
